props.name: mode
props.doc: Display mode: 'inline' shows a single unified view, 'side-by-side' shows two columns.

props.name: slides
props.doc: Array of slides to display.

props.name: autoplay
props.doc: Whether to automatically advance slides at the given interval.

props.name: interval
props.doc: Autoplay interval in milliseconds.

props.name: showIndicators
props.doc: Whether to show dot indicators at the bottom.

props.name: showArrows
props.doc: Whether to show left/right arrow buttons.

slots.name: renderSlide
slots.doc: Custom render function for slides, receiving the slide data and its index.

props.name: headers
props.doc: Column header definitions.

props.name: rows
props.doc: Array of row data objects.

props.name: keyBy
props.doc: Dot-notation key path used to derive unique keys for each row.

props.name: striped
props.doc: Whether to apply zebra striping to alternating rows.

props.name: hoverable
props.doc: Whether rows highlight on hover.

props.name: compact
props.doc: Whether to use compact row padding.

props.name: size
props.doc: DaisyUI size variant for the table (xs, sm, md, lg).

props.name: noHeaders
props.doc: Whether to hide the table header row.

props.name: sortBy
props.doc: Current sort configuration (controlled).

props.name: selectable
props.doc: Whether to show row selection checkboxes.

props.name: selectedKeys
props.doc: Set of currently selected row keys (controlled).

props.name: selectableKey
props.doc: Dot-notation key path used to derive the selectable key for each row.

props.name: expandable
props.doc: Whether rows can be expanded to show additional detail.

props.name: expandableKey
props.doc: Dot-notation key path used to derive the expandable key for each row.

props.name: containerClassName
props.doc: Additional CSS class for the outer scroll container.

slots.name: renderExpansion
slots.doc: Render function for expanded row content.

slots.name: renderActions
slots.doc: Render function for the actions column on each row.

slots.name: emptyText
slots.doc: Content displayed when the rows array is empty.

slots.name: footer
slots.doc: Content rendered in the table footer.

events.name: onSort
events.doc: Callback fired when a sortable column header is clicked.

events.name: onSelectionChange
events.doc: Callback fired when the selection changes.

props.name: value
props.doc: Currently selected date (controlled). Syncs the view month when changed.

props.name: events
props.doc: Array of events to display as colored dots on their respective days.

props.name: weekStartsOnSunday
props.doc: Whether weeks start on Sunday instead of Monday.

props.name: highlightWeekends
props.doc: Whether to visually highlight weekend days.

props.name: highlightToday
props.doc: Whether to highlight today's date with a ring indicator.

props.name: minDate
props.doc: Minimum selectable date. Days before this are disabled.

props.name: maxDate
props.doc: Maximum selectable date. Days after this are disabled.

props.name: color
props.doc: DaisyUI color for the selected day highlight.

slots.name: renderDay
slots.doc: Custom render function for day cells, receiving the date and its events.

events.name: onChange
events.doc: Callback fired when a day is clicked. Receives the selected Date object.

events.name: onEventClick
events.doc: Callback fired when an event dot is clicked.

props.name: data
props.doc: Array of numeric data points to plot.

props.name: type
props.doc: Chart type: line draws a stroke path, area fills below it, bar renders vertical bars.

props.name: height
props.doc: Height of the SVG in pixels.

props.name: width
props.doc: Width of the SVG in pixels. Defaults to `data.length * 8` if not provided.

props.name: color
props.doc: DaisyUI color name or CSS color string for the chart.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.doc: Stroke width for line/area charts in pixels.

props.name: curve
props.doc: Whether to use smooth Catmull-Rom curves instead of straight line segments.

props.name: fillOpacity
props.doc: Fill opacity for area charts (0 to 1).

props.name: showTooltip
props.doc: Whether to show a tooltip on hover displaying the data point value.

props.name: type
props.doc: The type of chart to render.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Category labels for the x-axis or pie/donut slices. Falls back to `data[].label` if not provided.

props.name: series
props.doc: Multi-series data for bar, line, and area charts.

props.name: data
props.doc: Simple data points for single-series or pie/donut charts.

props.name: height
props.doc: Chart height in pixels or CSS string.

props.name: width
props.doc: Chart width in pixels or CSS string.

props.name: color
props.doc: Default DaisyUI color applied to all series/data points without an explicit color.

props.name: options
props.doc: ApexCharts options object, deep-merged with the component's defaults.

props.name: showLegend
props.doc: Whether to show the chart legend.

props.name: animated
props.doc: Whether to enable chart animations.

props.name: title
props.doc: Optional title displayed above the chart.

props.name: color
props.doc: The color variant of the alert. Determines background and text styling.

props.name: dismissible
props.doc: Whether the alert can be dismissed by the user via a close button.

props.name: visible
props.doc:
Controlled visibility -- when provided, the parent manages show/hide.
When omitted the component manages its own internal visibility state.

slots.name: icon
slots.doc: Optional icon to display before the alert content.

events.name: onDismiss
events.doc: Callback fired when the alert is dismissed (via the close button).

props.name: color
props.doc: The DaisyUI color variant applied to the loading indicator.

props.name: size
props.doc: The size of the loading indicator.

props.name: variant
props.doc: The visual animation style of the loading indicator. Defaults to `"spinner"`.

props.name: width
props.doc: Width of the skeleton as a CSS value (e.g. `"200px"`, `"100%"`).

props.name: height
props.doc: Height of the skeleton as a CSS value (e.g. `"1rem"`, `"40px"`).

props.name: circle
props.doc: When `true`, renders the skeleton as a circle. If only one of `width`/`height` is set, it is used for both dimensions. When both are set, each is applied independently.

props.name: heading
props.doc: Heading text rendered inside the heading element.

props.name: headingAs
props.doc: HTML element to render the heading as. Defaults to `"h3"`.

props.name: description
props.doc: Descriptive message displayed below the heading.

slots.name: icon
slots.doc: Illustration or icon to display above the heading.

slots.name: action
slots.doc: Action element (e.g. a button) rendered below the description.

props.name: title
props.doc: Error title displayed as a heading. Defaults to `"Something went wrong"`.

props.name: message
props.doc: Descriptive error message displayed below the title.

props.name: retryLabel
props.doc: Custom label for the retry button. Defaults to `"Try again"`.

slots.name: icon
slots.doc: Optional icon or illustration rendered above the title.

events.name: onRetry
events.doc: Callback fired when the retry button is clicked. When provided, a retry button is rendered.

props.name: defaultDuration
props.doc: Default auto-dismiss duration in milliseconds. Defaults to `5000`. Set to `0` to disable auto-dismiss.

props.name: max
props.doc: Maximum number of simultaneously visible toasts. Oldest toasts are evicted when exceeded. Defaults to `5`.

props.name: position
props.doc: DaisyUI position classes applied to the toast container. Defaults to `['toast-end', 'toast-bottom']`.

slots.name: children
slots.doc: Child elements that will have access to the toast context.

props.name: toast
props.doc: The toast data object to render.

events.name: onDismiss
events.doc: Callback to dismiss this toast by its ID.

props.name: path
props.doc: SVG path `d` attribute for single-path icons. Mutually exclusive with `children`.

props.name: color
props.doc: DaisyUI color variant applied as a text color class.

props.name: size
props.doc: Predefined size preset. Defaults to `"md"`.

props.name: label
props.doc:
Accessible label for the icon. When provided, the SVG is given
`role="img"` and `aria-label`. When omitted, the icon is treated
as decorative and hidden from assistive technologies.

props.name: viewBox
props.doc: SVG `viewBox` attribute. Defaults to `"0 0 24 24"`.

props.name: size
props.doc: Button size preset. Defaults to `"md"`.

props.name: modes
props.doc: Ordered list of color scheme modes to cycle through. Defaults to `['light', 'dark', 'system']`.

props.name: tip
props.doc: The text content displayed in the tooltip.

props.name: position
props.doc: Position of the tooltip relative to the trigger. Defaults to `"top"`.

props.name: color
props.doc: DaisyUI color variant for the tooltip background.

props.name: open
props.doc: When `true`, the tooltip is always visible regardless of hover/focus state.

slots.name: children
slots.doc: The trigger element. Accepts a single child, a Fragment, or plain text.

props.name: text
props.doc: The text string to copy to the clipboard when clicked.

props.name: label
props.doc: Button label displayed in the idle state. Defaults to `"Copy"`.

props.name: successLabel
props.doc: Button label displayed after a successful copy. Defaults to `"Copied!"`.

props.name: successDuration
props.doc: Duration in milliseconds to show the success state before reverting. Defaults to `2000`.

props.name: color
props.doc: DaisyUI color variant or `"ghost"` for the button. Defaults to `"ghost"`.

props.name: size
props.doc: Button size. Defaults to `"sm"`.

events.name: onCopy
events.doc: Callback fired after a successful clipboard write.

props.name: source
props.doc: Raw markdown source text to render.

props.name: renderMarkdown
props.doc:
Custom render function that receives the raw markdown source and
returns an HTML string. When omitted a minimal built-in parser is used.

**Security:** The returned string is injected via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
It must be produced by a trusted source or explicitly sanitized to prevent XSS.
